questions.question_english:
Consider the following two statements: one is labeled
    as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R).
    Assertion (A): The Principle of Least Privilege
    should be applied when assigning user roles in
    the school's Management Information System (MIS).
    Reason (R): Granting users only the access rights
    strictly required to perform their jobs minimizes
    the risk of accidental or malicious data breaches.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is that both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A. Applying the Principle of Least Privilege in management information systems ensures that users receive only the minimum system access permissions necessary to perform their assigned administrative duties. This restriction minimizes potential damage from compromised credentials, limits exposure of confidential student records, and reduces risks of accidental or intentional data modification, thereby maintaining system integrity and strict data privacy standards.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। न्यूनतम विशेषाधिकार का सिद्धांत लागू करने से यह सुनिश्चित होता है कि उपयोगकर्ताओं को केवल उन कार्यों को करने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम प्रणाली पहुँच अनुमतियाँ प्राप्त होती हैं। यह प्रशासनिक अधिकारों को सीमित करने से संभावित क्षति को कम करता है, गोपनीय छात्र रिकॉर्ड के उजागर होने को सीमित करता है, और आकस्मिक या जानबूझकर डेटा संशोधन के जोखिम को कम करता है, जिससे प्रणाली की अखंडता और डेटा गोपनीयता मानकों को बनाए रखा जा सके।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Applying the Principle of Least Privilege in management information systems ensures users receive only the minimum system access permissions necessary to perform their assigned administrative duties.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following potential outcomes of using unofficial cloud storage (e.g., personal cloud drives) for storing official school records:
I. Loss of administrative control over data if the employee leaves
II. Potential violation of official data privacy and security guidelines
III. Increased interoperability with the official MIS
Which of the above statements represent significant risks?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III

questions.explanation_english: Storing official institutional records on personal, unapproved cloud drives introduces critical risks, including loss of administrative control over data when employees leave and potential non-compliance with data privacy mandates. Unofficial cloud storage lacks central oversight and audit logging, increasing data exposure risks and failing to provide structural interoperability with official management platforms.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनधिकृत क्लाउड स्टोरेज पर आधिकारिक संस्थागत रिकॉर्ड को संग्रहीत करने से महत्वपूर्ण जोखिम उत्पन्न होते हैं, जिसमें कर्मचारियों के छोड़ने पर डेटा पर प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण का नुकसान और डेटा गोपनीयता के नियमों का संभावित उल्लंघन शामिल है। अनधिकृत क्लाउड स्टोरेज में केंद्रीय निगरानी और ऑडिट लॉगिंग की कमी होती है, जिससे डेटा के उजागर होने के जोखिम बढ़ जाते हैं और यह आधिकारिक प्रबंधन प्लेटफार्मों के साथ संरचनात्मक इंटरऑपरेबिलिटी प्रदान करने में विफल रहता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Storing official institutional records on personal, unapproved cloud drives introduces critical risks, including loss of administrative control over data when employees leave and potential non-compliance with data privacy mandates. Unofficial cloud storage lacks central oversight and audit logging, increasing data exposure risks and failing to provide structural interoperability with official management platforms.

questions.question_english:
Identify the incorrect statement regarding the
     Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005, and
     digital records.
options_english:
Digital records are covered under the
         definition of “information” in the RTI Act.

Public authorities are mandated to
         computerize their records to facilitate easy
         access under Section 4 of the RTI Act.

A citizen cannot request information stored
         purely in an electronic format; they must
         ask for paper records only.

Emails sent from official government IDs can
         be subject to RTI queries, provided they do
         not fall under exemptions.
questions.explanation_english:
Under the Right to Information Act 2005, the
        definition of information explicitly encompasses
        records, documents, emails, and data stored in
        electronic formats. Citizens possess the statutory
        right to request information in electronic
        modes, including soft copies or printouts.
        Public authorities are required to computerize
        administrative records to facilitate efficient
        public access under transparency mandates.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। सूचना के अधिकार अधिनियम 2005 के तहत, सूचना की परिभाषा स्पष्ट रूप से इलेक्ट्रॉनिक प्रारूप में संग्रहीत रिकॉर्ड, दस्तावेज़, ईमेल और डेटा को शामिल करती है। नागरिकों को इलेक्ट्रॉनिक मोड में जानकारी का अनुरोध करने का वैधानिक अधिकार है, जिसमें सॉफ्ट कॉपी या प्रिंटआउट शामिल हैं। सार्वजनिक प्राधिकरणों को पारदर्शिता के तहत कुशल सार्वजनिक पहुँच को सुविधाजनक बनाने के लिए प्रशासनिक रिकॉर्ड को कंप्यूटरीकृत करने की आवश्यकता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A citizen cannot request information stored

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under the Right to Information Act 2005, the definition of information explicitly encompasses records, documents, emails, and data stored in electronic formats.

questions.question_english: Upon discovering that a teacher has mistakenly uploaded a sensitive confidential disciplinary report to the public section of the school website, what immediate action is required?

questions.explanation_english: The immediate required action is to remove the document immediately, assess data access, and report the incident internally.
